system.description:
• Effect: Apply a Metamagic option's base effect to a spell for free instead of paying with Spellburn, but the GM rolls on the Corruption Table afterwards. This is the risky, free route to Metamagic; you may always pay with Spellburn instead to avoid the Corruption roll. Uses per day: 1.
  • 5th level: 2 a day, and your second Wild Surge each day carries no Corruption risk.
  • 13th level: 3 a day, and your third also carries no Corruption risk.
  • 17th level: 4 a day.
  • 20th level: with a Bloodline Seat, your first Wild Surge each day also carries no Corruption risk.

activities.name: Wild Surge
activities.text: Apply a Metamagic base effect for free; the GM then rolls on the Corruption Table. From 5th your second Wild Surge each day carries no Corruption risk, from 13th your third too. Uses: 1 a day, 2 from 5th, 3 from 13th, 4 from 17th; from 20th, with a Bloodline Seat, your first is also free of Corruption risk.
